name: Uric Acid
overview: Uric Acid is a health topic that clinicians and patients frequently discuss during care planning in India and worldwide. Key considerations include uric acid is a heterocyclic compound of carbon, nitrogen, oxygen, and hydrogen with the formula c5h4n4o3; it forms ions and salts known as urates and acid urates, such as ammonium acid urate; uric acid is a product of the metabolic breakdown of purine nucleotides, and it is a normal component of urine. This summary is educational and should be paired with professional medical evaluation.
